title: Stat reveal: headline numbers (Canvas)
description: One to four headline statistics, each the hero of its own beat: digits roll like an odometer (or count up) and stop left to right, a gauge ring with lit ticks (or a bar) fills to the value when it is a share of a stated whole, the label rises in, and the hero slides out as the ring unwinds for the next number. A title and source line frame the piece, and a closing recap sets every number side by side. Any aspect ratio.

title.description: Heading at the top of the frame (empty for none)

values.description: The statistics in order, as plain numbers (12000, 4.2, 98); decimals are shown as written

default: of orders shipped the same day
raised to build the new depot
labels.description: What each number counts, read after the number (one per value)

prefixes.description: Small mark before each number, such as a currency sign (empty for none)

suffixes.description: Small unit after each number: %, M, bn, k, x, +, GW, km (empty for none); word units get a thin space

scales.description: The whole each value is a share of (10 for 7 out of 10); 0 for none. A % suffix means 100. Meters fill only for shares

decimals.description: Decimal places per number; -1 (or absent) shows the value as written

source.description: Source line at the foot of the frame (empty for none)

meter.description: Meter for shares: a gauge ring around the number, a bar under it, or none

count.description: Odometer digit roll, or a numeric count-up from zero

separator.description: Thousands separator; with '.' the decimal mark becomes ','

recap.description: End with every statistic side by side (two or more)

tempo.description: Speed of the count and meter fill

palette.description: Ground, ink, accent (meters, units, rules) and muted (source line); ink and muted are checked for 4.5:1 contrast

grid.description: Opacity of the drifting dot grid

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.

Beats: intro I = min(0.9, 0.1 D); recap R = clamp(0.22 D, 1.8, 3.2) when on and N > 1; beat b = (D - I - R) / N; stat k enters at I + k b and lands (count stops) at I + k b + 0.1 + clamp(0.45 b, 0.8, 1.6) / tempo; the page also publishes window.vgBeats.
